items.text: In four hospitals introducing monthly in-situ simulation for rapid response teams one at a time, does time from call to first critical intervention in real calls fall after introduction, adjusting for calendar time?
items.population: Rapid response calls at four hospitals
items.intervention: Monthly in-situ simulation with structured debriefing
items.comparator: Periods before introduction in the same hospitals
items.outcome: Time from call to first critical intervention
items.setting: Four hospitals of one health authority

items.text: How do rapid response teams, ward nurses and families experience the calls and the simulations, and what explains differences between hospitals?
items.population: Team members, ward nurses and families
items.outcome: Themes explaining change and differences between hospitals

finer: Feasible within the grant and faculty time; interesting to education leads and the health authority; novel in combining real-call outcomes with experience across hospitals; ethical with safety rules and consent; relevant to case review findings.
summary: One quantitative and one qualitative question.
